lead.t: Increased destruction: Immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), drug‑induced (e.g., quinine, penicillins), disseminated intravascular coagulation (sepsis, severe malaria), hypersplenism (schistosomiasis, portal hypertension)

snip.t: Increased destruction: Immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), drug‑induced (e.g., quinine, penicillins), disseminated intravascular coagulation (sepsis, severe malaria), hypersplenism (schistosomiasis, portal hypertension)
Immune thrombocytopenia → auto‑antibodies bind platelet GPIIb/IIIa → Fc‑mediated splenic phagocytosis → thrombocytopenia.
Neutropenia and thrombocytopenia — from direct marrow effects and immune-mediated destruction (HIV-associated immune thrombocytopenia resembles ITP)
